_note:
The division Sue's Angels were promoted into. The table, the results and the League Eight fixtures are transcribed from FA Full-Time as the season goes, and tableAsOf is the day the table was last copied. npm run verify derives the table from the results and fails the build if the two disagree, so a mistyped figure cannot publish quietly. Only League Eight fixtures are kept here: the other clubs' cup ties are not this club's matches.

NINE CLUBS, NOT TEN. Tyne & Thames FC were listed here and are not in the division: they are absent from Full-Time's League Eight table, from its club and team filters, and from every fixture published. They are not in League Six, Seven or Nine either, so they have left the league rather than been placed elsewhere in it. The site was naming them as a confirmed 26/27 opponent on the league page.

NINE CLUBS IS NOT EIGHTEEN MATCHES. A ten-club double round robin is 18 games, which is what the club played to win League Ten; nine clubs is 16. Nothing here derives a total - the list is club names only, and every figure the site publishes about a season is counted from match records - but the difference is the sort of thing a reader assumes, so it is written down.
